pattern.short_summary: The system opens with a concrete proposal rather than an empty field; the user reacts to it; the reaction becomes an input that yields a revised version of the same artifact.
pattern.definition: The system opens with a concrete proposal rather than an empty field; the user reacts to it; the reaction becomes an input that yields a revised version of the same artifact. The cycle repeats without returning to a blank specification.
pattern.structural_signature: A cycle in the control graph in which the previous output is carried into the next call together with the user's critique. Artifact identity persists across iterations — the next state is an edit of the current one, not an independent draw — so the state at round n depends on rounds 1 through n-1.

dimension.category_description: How users inspect, modify, scope, revise, accept, program, or interrupt generated work at the artifact level.
dimension.classification_boundary: Centers user control during or after generation, including editable intermediate generators and representations.
